title: Pretty yet small
text: Pretty yet small. The fabric is cute but I was hoping it would wrap around my bento box. It did not. Some linen napkins are bigger than this. I'm partly to blame since I failed to get dimensions for the bento box to make sure it would work. Still disappointing and not too sure what I'll use it for now.

product_metadata.title: Yu-soku Furoshiki- Wrapping Cloth/Reversible [Cotton] (Komon x Flax Ornament: Purple/Green)
features: Reversible. With a different color on each side (Purple / Green).
description: Furoshiki is a Japanese traditional wrapping cloth used to transport luggage, like a large handkerchief. Good for wrapping a gift, a lunchbox, a bottle, and various items. It is also nice with tapestry and tablecloths as well.
